summary: The merged rules use default-deny, UID ownership, trusted custom claims for administrators, server-only writes for Adaptive Scheduling and LINE pending-review data, strict schemas for core user data, and immutable ownership/timestamps. Emulator denial tests and Firebase rules compilation passed. Two bounded nested-list validation gaps remain for a future hardening pass.

findings.issue: Transaction items and profile consentHistory are type-checked as lists and have size limits, but the rules cannot currently validate every nested element's schema and string lengths.
findings.recommendation: Keep server-side generation for these arrays and add a compact, fixed nested schema or move variable audit entries into owner-scoped subcollections before broad production rollout.

findings.issue: The legacy bankNotifications client collection is intentionally denied by default and is no longer routed in the app; the active LINE import flow uses server-controlled pendingReview and callable functions instead.
findings.recommendation: Remove the unused legacy line-bank service after the new LINE import flow has completed device acceptance testing.
